title: A star rating
hints: Add max to defineProps: max: { type: Number, default: 5 }, and declare the event: const emit = defineEmits(["rate"]);
v-for="n in max" counts from 1 to max: <button v-for="n in max" :key="n" class="star" ...>★</button>
